QuestionStmt.S: Calculate the osmotic pressure of 0.03 mole of non electrolyte solute dissolved in 0.1 dm³ of water at 300 K. $R = 0.082 \, \text{dm}^3 \, \text{atm} \, \text{mol}^{-1} \, \text{K}^{-1}$

Solution.S:
Given: $n = 0.03$ mol, $V = 0.1$ dm³, $T = 300$ K, $R = 0.082$ dm³ atm mol⁻¹ K⁻¹.

Molarity:

$$C = \frac{n}{V} = \frac{0.03}{0.1} = 0.3 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$$

Osmotic pressure:

$$\pi = C R T = 0.3 \times 0.082 \times 300$$

$$= 0.3 \times 24.6 = 7.38 \approx 7.4 \text{ atm}$$

Thus the correct option is A.
